title: Extract the one-shot Engram CLI reader from engram_host_adapter.rs into engram_work_binding.rs
outcome: The process/CLI transport slice of the engram_host_adapter.rs split (parent w-fb2b0d02457c): the one-shot Engram CLI reader and the shared subprocess/process-tree code move, as a pure move, into an ordinary module under engram_host's transport, not a sibling include! fragment, with their process-tree and reaping tests. Byte-identical bodies, a visibility and import inventory in the commit note, and a provenance header (owns, does not own, split from).
